title: Borealis content pack (borealis-content/1)
description: Lossless JSON representation of an Aurora Builder 'elements' XML file (and its index). Keys are snake_case versions of the XML attribute names. Aliases are normalised (grant name->id, statistic->stat, cap->maximum, prerequisites->prerequisite). Derived/synthesised content (multiclass siblings, ASI/feat features, spell scrolls, proxy items, support-name expansion) is NOT stored. Unknown XML attributes go to extra.attributes and unknown child nodes to extra.children. Borealis extensions over the Phase 0a schema: ruleset tags, cross-ruleset mapping fields, forward-compatible custom rule kinds, 'extra' on every nested object, level/number minimum relaxed to 0, a PackManifest definition.

format.description: Schema identifier and major version. aurora-content/1 is the pre-rename id, accepted on read.

min_app_version.description: XML root attribute 'app'. A single component is read as '<n>.0'.

ignore.description: XML root attribute 'ignore': skip the whole file.

elements.description: Element definitions in file order. Later duplicates of an id replace earlier ones (custom load semantics).

appends.description: Extension records applied after all files are loaded.

Extra.description: Escape hatch preserving anything the XML had that the schema has no field for.

attributes.description: Unknown XML attributes, original names, string values.

children.description: Unknown child nodes in document order.

text.description: Trimmed inner text (or inner XML when the node had child elements).

Info.description: XML <info> block. Legacy files carry an 'update' part whenever <info> exists; here it is optional (by design).

name.description: Local file name for the saved copy.

IndexFile.description: Manifest of content files (XML <index>). Stored beside this document type; not part of a content pack.

name.description: File name under the index content directory. A name ending in 'index' denotes a nested index.

obsolete.description: XML <obsolete> instead of <file>: delete local copy.

ElementType.description: Open string, exact and case-sensitive. Known values are listed in x-known-types; unknown values are valid and handled by the default parser.

Setter.description: One <set name=".." ...>value</set>. Lookup by name is case-insensitive and returns the first match; duplicates are allowed and preserved in order.

attributes.description: Every XML attribute other than 'name', e.g. currency, lb, type, modifier, addition, abbreviation, url, weightless, excludeEncumbrance, bulk, override.

text.description: Trimmed inner text; may contain {{stat}} or $(stat) placeholders.

Sheet.description: XML <sheet>. Absent <sheet> is equivalent to {display:true} with no entries.

setters.description: Child <set> nodes of the rule, in order. Attribute shortcuts (spellcasting, prepared, allowReplace) are separate fields below, not duplicated here.

type.description: Target element type (informational; the target is resolved by id alone).

id.description: Element id to grant. XML attr 'id' or legacy 'name'.

spellcasting.description: Spellcasting class name for a granted Spell.

type.description: Candidate element type, or the special value 'List' for a text list.

name.description: Label and persistence key of the selection.

default_behaviour.description: XML attr default-behaviour; kept for round-trip, Borealis does not use it.

existing.description: Kept for round-trip; Borealis does not use it.

stat.description: XML attr stat on a select; kept for round-trip, Borealis does not use it.

name.description: Statistic group name, lower-cased and legacy-mapped (content-format.md 7.3.1).

value.description: Integer text (sign allowed, leading + removed) or a statistic group name (lower-cased, legacy-mapped, optional leading '-').

bonus.description: Stacking class; the highest value per class counts, classes add.

maximum.description: Integer text or group name. XML attr 'maximum' or legacy 'cap'.

UnknownRule.description: Authoring-tool escape hatch. Unknown rule tags make a legacy element invalid; the migrator should report and drop them.

supports.description: Supports expression over Spell elements, or a single spell id for <extend>.

prepared.description: <extend> with a spell id only: always prepared for each class the extension applies to once that class can cast the spell's level.

name.description: Spellcasting class name. Omitted = 'N/A' (allowed only with all=true).

SourceRef.description: Element-level <source> child (kept for round-trip; Borealis does not use it).

Multiclass.description: Nested <multiclass> of a Class element. The loader synthesises the sibling Multiclass element from this (content-format.md 6.3).

Extract.description: Item <extract>: contents of an equipment pack.

source.description: Name (not id) of a Source element, or Core/Internal.

supports.description: Explicit support tags in XML order (derived tags are not stored).

description.description: HTML fragment (inner XML of <description>, see content-format.md 3.3.3).

data.description: Structured type specific data for 2024 era element types; opaque to borealis-content.

Append.description: XML <append id=.. [type=..]>. Only supports, setters, rules and spellcasting have an effect (content-format.md 9.2).

CustomRule.description: Forward-compatible rule of a kind this version does not know (for example the 2024 kinds).

monster.description: Typed stat block carried in the `data` of a `Monster` element (borealis-content `MonsterData`; docs/monster-model.md).

cr.description: Challenge rating as a string so 1/8 stays exact (integers are also accepted).

monsterFeature.description: A trait, action, bonus action, reaction or legendary action.

save.description: First saving throw the text calls for.
